import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier, GradientBoostingClassifier
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
import os

# File paths
train_path = "./input/train.csv"
test_path = "./input/test.csv"
sample_submission_path = "./input/sample_submission.csv"
submission_output_path = "./submission/submission.csv"

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv(train_path)
test = pd.read_csv(test_path)
sample_sub = pd.read_csv(sample_submission_path)

# Identify columns
id_col = "id"
target_col = "species"
feature_cols = [c for c in train.columns if c not in (id_col, target_col)]

X_train = train[feature_cols].values
y_train = train[target_col].values
X_test = test[feature_cols].values
test_ids = test[id_col].values

# Validation split (holdout set model never trains on)
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# Train Random Forest with tuned hyperparameters
rf = RandomForestClassifier(
    n_estimators=800,
    max_depth=16,
    min_samples_leaf=1,
    class_weight="balanced",
    random_state=42,
    verbose=False,
    n_jobs=-1,
)
rf.fit(X_tr, y_tr)
proba_rf_val = rf.predict_proba(X_val)
proba_rf_test = rf.predict_proba(X_test)

# Train Gradient Boosting with balanced class weights
gbc = GradientBoostingClassifier(
    n_estimators=400,
    learning_rate=0.03,
    max_depth=6,
    min_samples_leaf=10,
    subsample=0.8,
    random_state=42,
    verbose=False,
)
gbc.fit(X_tr, y_tr)
proba_gb_val = gbc.predict_proba(X_val)
proba_gb_test = gbc.predict_proba(X_test)

# Stack base models' predictions - KEEP ALL COLUMNS now
base_probs_val = np.column_stack([proba_rf_val, proba_gb_val])
base_probs_test = np.column_stack([proba_rf_test, proba_gb_test])

# Train Logistic Regression meta-layer on stacked predictions
meta_lr = LogisticRegression(
    multi_class="multinomial", solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000, random_state=42, C=1.0
)
meta_lr.fit(base_probs_val, y_val)
proba_meta_val = meta_lr.predict_proba(base_probs_val)
proba_meta_test = meta_lr.predict_proba(base_probs_test)

# Calculate validation log loss for meta-layer - use correct labels order
val_logloss = log_loss(y_val, proba_meta_val)
print(f"Stacking Ensemble Val Log Loss: {val_logloss:.6f}")

# Final prediction clipping and normalization (competition spec: clamp to [1e-15, 1-1e-15])
classes = np.unique(y_train)
n_classes = len(classes)

proba_test_clipped = np.clip(proba_meta_test, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
proba_test_normalized = proba_test_clipped / proba_test_clipped.sum(
    axis=1, keepdims=True
)

# Create submission DataFrame matching sample_submission.csv column structure
submission_df = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_ids.values})

# Add probability columns in the same order as sample_submission.csv
for col in sample_sub.columns:
    if col == "id":
        continue
    # Get row index from sample_submission to maintain column order
    submission_df[col] = proba_test_normalized.T[n_classes][col]

# Ensure we have exactly n_classes probability rows aligned properly
submission_df = submission_df.drop("id", axis=1)
final_submission = pd.DataFrame()
final_submission["id"] = test_ids.values
for col in sample_sub.columns:
    if col != "id":
        final_submission[col] = proba_test_normalized[:, int(sample_sub[col].iloc[0])]

final_submission.to_csv(submission_output_path, index=False)

# Print the logloss metric
print(f"Validation Log Loss: {val_logloss:.6f}")
